answer: Miscellaneous >> Islamic Names Question ID: 50209 Country: India Title: Baby Name Question: Is it fine to keep name Azan for a baby boy and Umme Kulsum for bay girl? Answer ID: 50209 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 258/257/N=01/1435) Umme Kulsum is very nice name for girl. It is the name of one of the daughters of the holy Prophet Muhammad (صلى الله عليه وسلم). And Azan is also correct name for a boy. It means to inform. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
